components.name: icon
components.description: An SVG, icon-font glyph or Material Icons ligature, drawn as a named, fixed-size placeholder box because the glyph itself cannot become a label.

props.name: hint
props.description: Name taken from the icon (class, test id or ligature text); the placeholder is called icon_<hint>.

components.name: card
components.description: A container with a raised or outlined surface (Material UI Card, Bootstrap card).

props.name: variant
props.description: Outlined when the surface has a visible border and no shadow, otherwise elevation.

components.name: paper
components.description: A plain surface (Material UI Paper that is not part of a Card, Alert, AppBar or Accordion).

props.name: variant
props.description: Outlined when the surface has a visible border and no shadow, otherwise elevation.

components.name: divider
components.description: A thin separator line (hr, role=separator, Material UI Divider).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the line.

components.name: chip
components.description: A compact pill with a label and an optional leading icon, avatar or delete control.

props.name: label
props.description: The chip text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Outlined when the chip has a border and no fill.

components.name: avatar
components.description: A circle (or rounded square) holding a photo or initials.

props.name: shape
props.description: Read from the corner radius.

props.name: initials
props.description: The text shown when there is no image.

props.name: src
props.description: Image source when the avatar holds a photo.

components.name: badge
components.description: A small count or dot pinned to a corner of another element, or an inline pill label (Bootstrap).

props.name: content
props.description: The text of the count; empty for a dot.

props.name: variant
props.description: A dot has no content.

components.name: alert
components.description: A status message with an optional icon and action.

props.name: severity
props.description: Read from the Material UI class (standardError, colorWarning, ...).

props.name: variant
props.description: Read from the Material UI filled / outlined class.

components.name: appbar
components.description: The top bar of a screen (header with role=banner, Material UI AppBar), pinned while the page scrolls.

props.name: title
props.description: The bar title text.

props.name: position
props.description: The computed CSS position; fixed and sticky pin the bar.

components.name: toolbar
components.description: A row of controls, usually inside an app bar (role=toolbar, Material UI Toolbar).

components.name: breadcrumbs
components.description: A navigation trail (nav aria-label=breadcrumb, Material UI Breadcrumbs, Bootstrap .breadcrumb).

props.name: separator
props.description: The separator text between items.

components.name: accordion
components.description: A header that opens and closes a body; the content below moves out of the way.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the body is shown when the page loads (aria-expanded of the trigger).

signals.name: open
signals.description: 1 while the body is shown, 0 while it is hidden; the trigger toggles it.

components.name: modal
components.description: A dialog that blocks the page until it is dismissed (role=dialog or alertdialog, Material UI Dialog, Bootstrap .modal).

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog title text.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether the dialog blocks the page behind it: a backdrop layer is drawn. false gives a floating dialog with no backdrop.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown when the page loads.

signals.name: open
signals.description: 1 while the dialog is shown; an opener sets it to 1, a button inside the dialog (and the backdrop, when the dialog is dismissible) sets it to 0.

components.name: drawer
components.description: A panel that slides in from a screen edge over a dimmed page (Material UI Drawer, a navigation side sheet).

props.name: anchor
props.description: The screen edge the panel is docked to.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is shown when the page loads.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel title text.

signals.name: open
signals.description: 1 while the drawer is shown; an opener sets it to 1 and a closer sets it to 0.

signals.name: slide_in
signals.description: Slides the panel in from its edge; played when the opener is pressed.

signals.name: slide_out
signals.description: Slides the panel back out; played when a closer is pressed.

components.name: select
components.description: A closed field that opens a list of options and shows the chosen one; maps to lv_dropdown (native select, role=combobox, Material UI Select).

props.name: selected
props.description: Index of the selected option.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown by the closed field when no option is selected; it becomes the first option.

components.name: menu
components.description: A button that opens a floating list of commands (role=menu, Material UI Menu, Bootstrap dropdown menu).

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is shown when the page loads.

signals.name: open
signals.description: 1 while the menu is shown; the opener sets it to 1 and pressing an item or outside the popup sets it to 0.

components.name: snackbar
components.description: A short message bar that floats over the page, usually at the bottom, with an optional action (Material UI Snackbar, Bootstrap toast).

props.name: message
props.description: The message text.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the snackbar is shown when the page loads.

signals.name: open
signals.description: 1 while the snackbar is shown; an opener sets it to 1 and a button inside the snackbar sets it to 0.

components.name: date-picker
components.description: A month grid of days (ARIA date picker, Material UI DateCalendar); maps to lv_calendar.

props.name: shownYear
props.description: Year of the month the grid shows.

props.name: shownMonth
props.description: Month (1 to 12) the grid shows.

props.name: selectedDay
props.description: Day of the shown month that is selected; 0 when none.

props.name: today
props.description: Day of the shown month marked as today; 0 when none.

props.name: header
props.description: Whether lv_calendar draws its own month header with arrows (false for a grid that has its own).

components.name: stepper
components.description: A row or column of numbered steps with labels and connectors (Material UI Stepper, ol of steps).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction the steps run.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of steps.

props.name: active
props.description: Index of the step marked active (aria-current=step or a Mui-active class); the converter reports -1 when none is marked.

props.name: completed
props.description: Number of completed steps.

components.name: pagination
components.description: A row of page buttons with previous and next, the current page highlighted (Material UI Pagination, Bootstrap .pagination).

props.name: count
props.description: Number of items in the list, the previous and next arrows included.

props.name: current
props.description: Index of the item marked aria-current (or Mui-selected / active) in that list; the converter reports -1 when none is marked.

components.name: tabs
components.description: A tab bar plus one panel per tab (role=tablist / tab / tabpanel, Material UI Tabs); maps to lv_tabview.

props.name: active
props.description: Index of the open tab.

props.name: position
props.description: Side of the panels the tab bar sits on.

components.name: appbar-tabs
components.description: Working tabs whose strip sits inside an app bar and whose panels are elsewhere on the page.

props.name: active
props.description: Index of the open tab.

signals.name: selected
signals.description: Index of the open tab; pressing a tab sets it and the panels bind their visibility to it.

components.name: bottom-navigation
components.description: A bar of 3 to 5 icon-over-label actions pinned to the bottom edge of the screen (Material UI BottomNavigation); maps to an lv_tabview with the tab bar at the bottom.

props.name: active
props.description: Index of the selected action.

components.name: switch
components.description: An on/off toggle (role=switch, Material UI Switch); maps to lv_switch.

props.name: checked
props.description: The state the page shows (aria-checked, the checkbox behind it, or Mui-checked).

props.name: disabled
props.description: aria-disabled, disabled or Mui-disabled.

components.name: textfield
components.description: A labelled text box (textbox, input and textarea with a label, Material UI TextField); maps to lv_textarea with the label and helper text as labels.

props.name: label
props.description: The field label text.

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text.

props.name: helperText
props.description: The helper or error text under the field.

props.name: multiline
props.description: A textarea, aria-multiline, or a multiline Material UI input.

props.name: password
props.description: type=password: the text is masked.

props.name: error
props.description: aria-invalid or a Material UI error state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The field is disabled.

components.name: slider
components.description: Pick a value on a line (role=slider, Material UI Slider); maps to lv_slider.

props.name: min
props.description: aria-valuemin.

props.name: max
props.description: aria-valuemax.

props.name: value
props.description: aria-valuenow (the first thumb of a range slider).

props.name: disabled
props.description: The slider is disabled.

components.name: progress
components.description: How far a task has got (role=progressbar, Material UI LinearProgress and CircularProgress); maps to lv_bar or lv_arc.

props.name: variant
props.description: A bar or a ring.

props.name: value
props.description: aria-valuenow, clamped to the range; 40 percent of it when indeterminate.

props.name: min
props.description: aria-valuemin.

props.name: max
props.description: aria-valuemax.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: No value: drawn as a static 40 percent bar or arc (LVGL XML has no animated progress).

widgets.name: button
widgets.description: A button; the element's text becomes a label inside it.

widgets.name: dropdown
widgets.description: A drop-down list; the options come from the element's options attribute.
